## Articles

- [How I built a privacy-first Indian passport photo maker](https://chintanpuggalok.com/writing/building-a-private-indian-passport-photo-tool/): the single consolidated article covering photo sizing, 300 DPI/A4 printing, browser-based processing, WebKit drafts, safe diagnostics, prioritized tests, measured model experiments, and the proposed native-mobile roadmap.
- [How twitter.com redirects to x.com](https://chintanpuggalok.com/writing/url-forwarding): HTTP redirects inspected through the browser network panel.
